slides.title: Hissa = [[part / total]]
points: Problem: har row pe **total** kaise laayein?

slides.title: Jawab: [[SUM() OVER ()]]
points: Har row ke saath **grand total** chipak jaata
GROUP BY nahi, rows **collapse nahi** hoti
slides.note: OVER () ke andar kuch nahi = **sab ka sum, har row pe** 🙌

slides.title: Percent [[query]]
slides.code:
SELECT name, salary,
  ROUND(salary * 100.0
    / SUM(salary) OVER (), 1)
  AS pct
FROM employees;

slides.title: Total = [[3,50,000]]
slides.note: Sab jodo → **100%** (rounding se ±0.1 ho sakta hai)

slides.title: Dept ke [[andar]] share
slides.note: PARTITION BY dept → har dept ka apna **100%**

slides.why: PostgreSQL / SQL Server mein int ÷ int = **int** → 25.7 ban jaata **25** 💀 (MySQL bach jaata)
